'''Chugg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reigat]] who served as the personal [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to [[Kaylo NaKuda]] as well as serving as the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] to the [[Cantina|bar]] on [[Stend VI]] known as [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]].

==Biography==
Chugg started his career as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] racer as part of [[Team NaKuda]], a racing team sponsored by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaylo NaKuda]]. He was in a terrible crash that he barely survived. NaKuda nursed him back to health and in return Chugg pledged his loyalty to the crime lord. NaKuda employed him as his bodyguard and security for his garage, [[Kuda's Compound]], and the bouncer for the adjoining [[Cantina|bar]] [[The Pits (cantina)|The Pits]].

==Personality and traits==
As a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reigat]], Chugg looked very intimidating. He had [[Color/Legends|gray]] mottled skin and dark blue lips, eyelids, and hair. He was very heavily muscled on par with a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] or a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. He was fanatically loyal to Nakuda and was willing to even die for the crime boss.

==Skills and abilities==
Befitting a bodyguard and bouncer, Chugg was ferocious with his fists and used his strength to manhandle his opponents. He was also decent with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Knife/Legends|throwing knives]]. His accident seemed to severely decrease his mental capacity. Despite his history he was untalented in swoop racing which may have been a side effect of his accident. He was very intimidating when he wanted to be.

==Equipment==
Chugg carried around a small arsenal at all times. This included a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]], a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], two [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknives]] and a triple-headed [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].

==Behind the scenes==
Chugg was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Greg Smith (illustrator)|Greg Smith]].
